reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering food, minerals, fish, volcanic resources, tackle, dried products, an artifact, debris, and a musical block were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover dynamic-name grammar, placeholders, established tackle and resource names, item descriptions, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

DishOTheSea_Description.source: This'll keep you warm in the cold sea air.
DishOTheSea_Description.translation: Îți va ține de cald în aerul rece al mării.

Dolomite_Description.source: It can occur in coral reefs, often near an underwater volcano.
Dolomite_Description.translation: Poate apărea în recifele de corali, adesea în apropierea unui vulcan subacvatic.

Dorado_Name.preservationReason: Dorado is the established fish name already used throughout the Romanian locale and therefore remains identical to the English source.

Dorado_Description.source: A fierce carnivore with brilliant orange scales.
Dorado_Description.translation: Un prădător feroce cu solzi portocalii strălucitori.

DragonTooth_Description.source: These are rumored to be the teeth of ancient serpents. The enamel is made of pure iridium!
DragonTooth_Description.translation: Se spune că aceștia sunt dinții unor șerpi străvechi. Smalțul este din iridiu pur!

DressedSpinner_Description.source: The metal tab and colorful streamers create an enticing spectacle for fish. Increases the bite-rate when fishing.
DressedSpinner_Description.translation: Plăcuța metalică și panglicile colorate creează un spectacol atrăgător pentru pești. Mărește frecvența mușcăturilor la pescuit.

DriedStarfish_Description.source: A starfish from the primordial ocean. It's an unusually pristine specimen!
DriedStarfish_Description.translation: O stea de mare din oceanul primordial. Este un exemplar neobișnuit de bine conservat!

Driftwood_Description.source: A piece of wood from the sea.
Driftwood_Description.translation: O bucată de lemn adusă de mare.

DrumBlock_Description.source: Plays a drum sound when you walk past.
DrumBlock_Description.translation: Redă un sunet de tobă când treci pe lângă el.
